decision.title: XSLT conformance sweep after the leftovers (packet 4.20)
decision.summary: The XSLT sweep adds xsl:merge order checks, [before 1] tailorings, record constructors, schema-awareness leftovers and error codes the specification gives, raising XT40 from 11,826 to 11,912 passed.

body.p: , after , , , , , , , , , , . Verified as asks: the debug preset, the unit tests touched (collation, xslt, schema, xpath, xquery), clang-tidy on the files changed, and the whole XT40 suite with the release driver after each change, compared case by case. XT40 11,826 to 11,912 passed, 0 errors, no case lost. QT4: fn-transform XQ40 129 to 130 of 137; the XQ40 and XP40 sets an inline function's module or a QName cast touch unchanged.

item.p: xsl:merge (15.3, 15.4): XTDE2220 by stability: each merge tuple ends with its anchor's and item's positions; an input sequence is in merge-key order exactly when its tuples keep their order once the stable sort ran, one fold over the sorted tuples (sort-before-merge sources are not checked). XTDE2210 for computed lang, order, collation, case-order and data-type (every source's value, compared when evaluated, before the order check). validation and type of xsl:merge-source validate the documents for-each-source reads (not by default-validation, as xsl:source-document). merge 97 to 107.

[before 1] tailorings (UTS #35, Part 5, 3.7) in src/collation_tailoring.c: the reset is the root primary less one, so what follows sorts before the reset's element. Swedish is vendored (third_party/cldr sv.xml, 's default: data as CLDR publishes it); the merge cases of Swedish city names need it once the order is checked. [before 2] and [before 3] stay unsupported.

Record constructors (5.4.2.2): the reader synthesizes the "implicit xsl:function" beside the xsl:record-type, as the specification writes it (a parameter per non-static field sharing its as and select, an xsl:map of xsl:map-entry). Replaces 's delayed place. A field's initial value given as content is not a default yet.

Schema awareness ('s leftovers): element validation does not apply Validation Root Valid (ID/IDREF) (25.2), through sxml_schema_scope_validate_node (skips_id_constraints, internal); XTTE1555 is cvc-id.1/.2 of a document only; xs:untypedAtomic as a validation type (xs:string, then annotated, XTTE1540 for element children); XTTE1545 for a new attribute of a QName- or NOTATION-based type; XTSE0265. The XSLT driver gives assertions the environment's schema.

Codes the specification gives: XTSE0550 (mode lists), XTSE0710, XTSE1570 (one table in the reader), XTSE3440, XTSE3460, XTSE0580, XTSE1295, XTDE0830/XTDE0860 (a computed lexical QName with an unbound prefix), XTDE0905, XTDE0920, XTTE0945, XTDE1360.
Modules (): xsl:iterate bodies and inline functions take the IR module of the code they are written in, so their errors name the included module.

xs:QName casts of a string constant resolve while lowering with the expression's statically known namespaces (not XQuery's, whose direct constructors bind prefixes the static context does not show); xml-version-016 passes.
fn:transform: enable-assertions (false by default) disables xsl:assert through the unit evaluation's extension.
Driver: ISO-8859-1 and UTF-16 serializations are decoded for the assertions on them (an expected file that is not UTF-8 is not compared).

Lazy globals (XTDE3052; design, not done): XSLT globals are computed eagerly before the initial template ('s leftover), so an unread abstract variable raises XTDE3052 and an unread global that reads an absent context item raises XPDY0002 (accept-042, -043a, document-4061..-4067). The design: a global read becomes an IR expression (GLOBAL_READ) the machine evaluates as a step: a set slot is its value; an absent one with an initializer pushes the initializer's call and stores its value (BEING_COMPUTED raises XTDE0640, the cycle, as XQDY0054 does for XQuery); XSLT's eager global part then computes nothing. It needs src/evaluator*.c, another packet's files during this sweep.

Left, with causes: XTDE3490 and the merge collection with ?select= (merge-097, a Saxon collection URI); merge-001a/-016 (the hoist pass evaluates the key-array text for an empty merge, perf's); typed modes reading name tests as schema-element() and XTSE3105 (the template lowering, another packet's file); xml-version-007 (the value template grammar rejects C0 controls of XML 1.1); namespace-2606 (namespace undeclarations of inherit-namespaces="no" in the evaluator's constructors); namespace-6202 (fn and the other XPath prefixes are predeclared in XSLT too; XSLT 4.0 has only xml); a string cast to xs:QName at run time still uses the module's namespaces (); docbook-004 (an xml:id fragment in xsl:source-document); fn:transform's cache false (fn-transform-27), xslt-version 2.0 (82e: the suite expects a 3.0 processor) and fn-transform-94 (the QT4 driver's base URI of a query file); xsl:copy of JNodes (needs a parentless JNode with a key, xdm.h); XTDE0430/0440 (XQDY0102 in the evaluator); system-property and function-available with a non-NCName (src/function_library_xslt.c, another packet's uncommitted file).
